name: sportsleague
description: One league per sport for the sports broadcasts: computed standings (`standings [sport]`) folded from the deterministic schedule, plus monthly seasons that climax in a single championship game between the top two teams — Deadball's World Series (`worldseries`) and the CPhL's Coldwater Cup (`cup`). `champions` keeps the history. Each sport supplies its own fold (W-L-RD plus a hitting race — average, home runs, RBI — for baseball; W-L-OTL-PTS plus a scoring race and a casualty count for hockey). Per-player races are folded out of the at-bat/scoring beats the sim already emits, so they can never disagree with the games that aired.

seasonDays.note: in-game days per season before the championship (SPORTS_SEASON_DAYS in index.js)

minWorldSeriesGames.note: runner-up must have played this many before a final can seed
